messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content:
Here are some engaging true or false questions to help students get to know you better. These prompts encourage interaction and break the ice effectively.

1.  I have visited more than ten countries in my lifetime. (True/False)
2.  My favorite color is actually blue, not green as most people assume. (True/False)
3.  I used to play a musical instrument professionally before teaching. (True/False)
4.  I can speak three languages fluently right now today. (True/False)
5.  My biggest fear is public speaking, which surprises many of you. (True/False)
6.  I have never broken a bone in my entire life so far. (True/False)
7.  I prefer coffee over tea every single morning without exception. (True/False)
8.  I once won a local spelling bee competition when I was young. (True/False)
9.  I am afraid of spiders, which might be surprising to see. (True/False)
10. I have traveled to Japan at least once during my career. (True/False)
11. I enjoy hiking on weekends more than watching movies at home. (True/False)
12. I have a pet dog named Max who loves to fetch. (True/False)
13. I believe that learning should always be fun and interactive for everyone. (True/False)
14. I have taught this specific subject for over five years already. (True/False)
15. I like to bake cookies whenever I have free time available. (True/False)
16. I am planning to take a trip to Europe next summer soon. (True/False)
17. 私は先生です。
18. I have read more than one hundred books this year alone. (True/False)
19. I prefer working out in the morning rather than in the evening. (True/False)
20. I have never tried skydiving, but I would like to try it someday. (True/False)
21. I collect vintage postcards from different countries around the world regularly. (True/False)
22. I am a fan of classical music, especially Beethoven’s symphonies often played. (True/False)
23. I have volunteered at a local animal shelter several times recently. (True/False)
24. I believe that failure is an important part of the learning process always. (True/False)
25. I have a secret talent for juggling that I rarely show anyone. (True/False)
26. I prefer rainy days because they make me feel cozy and productive inside. (True/False)
27. I have written a short story that was published in a magazine. (True/False)
28. I am excited to meet all of you and start this new journey together. (True/False)
29. I have a garden where I grow vegetables and flowers beautifully every season. (True/False)
30. I believe that kindness is the most important quality a person can have. (True/False)
